name: Fauzi Fadhlurrohman
intro: I run campaigns, research how people make decisions, and build small tools for the work that follows.
about: I study English at Universitas Indonesia. A lot of my work starts with people’s questions: why someone hesitates to apply, what a first-home buyer needs to know, or where a teammate loses time in a workflow.

I’ve led marketing across several teams, presented a communications strategy to a property client, and built a referral workflow in Google Apps Script. The useful part is often where a recommendation becomes something a team can try or run.
I also work on team cases in business and public policy. They give me a reason to compare my first idea with what the research and the constraints actually support.
